sn22.111:1.2: rūpe bhikkhave yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi yā taṇhā taṃ pajahatha
sn22.111:1.3: evantaṃ rūpaṃ pahīnaṃ bhavissati ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvaṅkataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammaṃ.
sn22.111:1.7: viññāṇe yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi yā taṇhā taṃ pajahatha
sn22.111:1.8: evantaṃ viññāṇaṃ pahīnaṃ bhavissati ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvaṅkataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammanti.
